استئب (form X)
# اُسْتُئِبَّ (ustuʔibba) /us.tu.ʔib.ba/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَأَبَّ (istaʔabba)
# اِسْتَئِبَّ (istaʔibba) /is.ta.ʔib.ba/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِسْتَأَبَّ (istaʔabba)
# اِسْتَئِبِّ (istaʔibbi) /is.ta.ʔib.bi/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِسْتَأَبَّ (istaʔabba)
